diagnosis.overview: The agent lacks reliable retrieval and deep-read tools to access exact source data from real websites, spreadsheets, images, and documents, leading to generic or approximated outputs, close-but-wrong values, and incomplete deliverables across tasks.
diagnosis.root_cause: The agent lacks reliable retrieval and deep-read tools to access exact source data from real websites, spreadsheets, images, and documents, leading to generic or approximated outputs, close-but-wrong values, and incomplete deliverables across tasks.
diagnosis.general_mechanism: 1) Wire in a robust retrieval and deep-read tool (full web browser with JavaScript rendering, OCR, PDF/spreadsheet parsers) to ensure exact source data extraction, replacing any inadequate existing tools that cause repeated errors. 2) Add a harness prompt rule that forbids generating sample/placeholder data and requires cross-checking all required outputs (files, sections, pivot tables, formatting, word limits) against the task specification before final submission.
